channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Fort Bend County Sheriff’s Office deputy dies following weekend hit-and-run in Houston
item.description: The Houston Police Department is currently investigating the incident. The Lewis family has not yet shared details regarding a possible memorial service.

item.title: Waymo is officially giving rides to Houstonians in fully self-driving cars
item.description: The autonomous vehicle company is expanding its ride-hailing services to Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. Select riders will receive invitations to ride on Tuesday, with other new riders admitted on a rolling basis.

item.title: Hello Houston (February 24, 2026)
item.description: Today: We discuss a landmark social media addiction trial, talk with New York Times best-selling author Meg Medina, explore how influencers are driving the Texas Democratic Senate race, and more.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (February 24, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters, we have – The Commuter Cut – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: Galveston cruises unaffected amid Mexico safety concerns
item.description: As of Tuesday, travel advisory warnings around Mexico ranged from “do not travel” in places like Mexico's state of Jalisco, to “exercise normal precautions” in areas such as Costa Maya, a popular cruise destination.

item.title: Fire crews monitor northeast Harris County blaze after winds shift south
item.description: Houston Fire Department District Chief Robert Ausmus said that the Caddo Fire near Greens Bayou was about 75 percent contained by Tuesday afternoon. The blaze has extended about 200 acres.

item.title: ‘We didn’t move here to be poisoned’: Fort Bend residents renew fight over concrete plant construction
item.description: Fort Bend County elected officials, local community organizers and members of the environment nonprofit Air Alliance held a public meeting over the weekend at a Rosharon neighborhood pavilion to voice their opposition against constructing the facility.

item.title: Appeals court strikes down AG’s effort to halt Harris County’s immigrant legal services fund
item.description: While the letter appears to be a legal win for Harris County, justices concluded that the opinion won't prevent the state from arguing that the county's Immigrant Legal Services Fund is a violation of the state's constitution.

item.title: Writer George Saunders offers a nuanced exploration of an oil tycoon society might deem ‘evil’
item.description: Ahead of a reading in Houston Feb. 25, Saunders discusses his novel, "Vigil," which takes readers inside the thoughts and choices of an oil and gas tycoon who's on his deathbed reflecting about his life.

item.title: Houston Rep. Al Green again removed from Congress during Trump speech
item.description: Green, who also was escorted out of President Donald Trump's address to Congress last year, held up a sign reading, "Black People Aren't Apes!" on Tuesday night as Trump walked into the House chamber.
